title: IMD Issues Yellow Warning for 14 Odisha Districts, Forecasting Rain and Thunderstorms Over Next 3 Hours - Pragativadi
article_text:
​The India Meteorological Department (IMD) issued a yellow weather warning on Friday afternoon for 14 districts across Odisha, forecasting light to moderate rainfall accompanied by thunder and lightning at isolated places over the subsequent three hours.

​According to the IMD’s nowcast warning released at 12:20 PM, residents across multiple regions have been advised to exercise caution as active weather systems move through the state.

​Affected Districts Under the Yellow Warning

​The weather agency stated that the districts likely to experience sudden downpours and lightning include:

​Puri, Khordha (including Bhubaneswar), and Cuttack (Kataka)

​Ganjam, Jagatsinghpur, and Kendrapara

​Bhadrak, Baleshwar, Mayurbhanj, and Keonjhar (Kendujhar)

​Jajpur, Dhenkanal, Nayagarh (Nayagada), and Angul (Anugola)

​The nowcast explicitly highlights Cuttack city within the immediate impact zone, urging urban commuters and citizens to stay alert.

​Safety Advisories

​With sudden thunderstorms posing risks of lightning strikes and waterlogging in low-lying areas, meteorological officials have advised the public to monitor local weather updates closely and avoid open spaces or tall trees during lightning activity.
